scripts.release:variants: pnpm release:check && pnpm release:check-tag && pnpm exec ponado-docker-image --mode core --no-sha-tag && pnpm exec ponado-docker-image --mode typst --no-sha-tag
scripts.release: pnpm release:check && bumpp --git-check --yes && pnpm release:variants && pnpm exec ponado-docker-image --mode prod
scripts.release:patch: pnpm release:check && bumpp patch --git-check --yes && pnpm release:variants && pnpm exec ponado-docker-image --mode prod
scripts.release:minor: pnpm release:check && bumpp minor --git-check --yes && pnpm release:variants && pnpm exec ponado-docker-image --mode prod
scripts.release:major: pnpm release:check && bumpp major --git-check --yes && pnpm release:variants && pnpm exec ponado-docker-image --mode prod
scripts.build:full: pnpm exec ponado-docker-image build --mode dev --no-push --tag full --no-floating --no-sha-tag
scripts.build:core: pnpm exec ponado-docker-image build --mode dev --no-push --tag core --no-floating --no-sha-tag --build-arg WITH_VIPS_EXTRAS=false
scripts.build:typst: pnpm exec ponado-docker-image build --mode dev --no-push --tag typst --no-floating --no-sha-tag --build-arg WITH_VIPS=false
scripts.build:all: pnpm build:full && pnpm build:core && pnpm build:typst
